_note: Public sites checked every day by .github/workflows/site-check.yml. Read-only: the check loads pages, it never changes a site. warn_only sites report but do not fail the run. allow_markers lists record markers (exact pattern text from RECORD_MARKERS) the owner approved for that site, e.g. the free Virginia Forge index (owner, Nov 11 2026): "allow_markers": ["\"records\"\\s*:\\s*\\["]. expect / expect_og_image / forbid: text that must be on the home page, the share picture it must use, and text that must never appear on any page.
